card.name: Start of tremor and similar rare terms
card.fires_on: The first piece of a long medical word, mostly "trem" of tremor, in lists of symptoms. Also the opening letter of words like rhabdomyolysis, RISKS and Zoroastrian.

modes.label: Tremor in symptom lists
modes.description: The piece "trem" starting tremor or tremors in lists of neuromuscular or withdrawal symptoms.

modes.label: Opening letter of split words
modes.description: A single capital letter or letter starting a long word that is split into pieces.

modes.label: Word after including
modes.description: The word "including" before a list of neurological problems such as ataxia.
modes.example: coordination abnormalities,<< including>> ataxia and gait disturbances.

card.writes: It suppresses word starts like hydro and electro, so it seems to steer the next piece away from those; the promoted tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It fires at the start of a hard word like tremor when the word is split up, usually in lists of side effects.
